name: Hissabeth
bio: Archetype: Ultimate Spam, Genesis damage, Petrify. ⌽ Starts the battle with a certain amount of [Snake's Den], which is converted into a versatile skill [Hiss!] at turn start or by using S2. Using S2 with insufficient [Snake's Den] gives Moxie instead. ⌽ [Hiss!] inflicts [Serpentile Scales] on the enemy, does not consume AP, and counts as an Ult. ⌽ Enemies with [SS] take Genesis damage at turn end, then [SS] stacks are converted back to [Snake's Den] stacks on self. ⌽ Inflicts [Rigidity] and gains Moxie when hitting an enemy with [SS]. ⌽ Ult increases the Genesis damage dealt by [SS], then reclaims all [SS] stacks from target at round end and transforms them into [Hiss!] incantations instead of [Snake's Den]. ⌽ Ult and [Hiss!] don't take up hand space.
